summary: First-finish smoke test of TravelMate AI. Backend: 10/10 critical endpoints working (GET /, destinations list/detail/404, chat POST/GET/DELETE with Groq AI reply, itinerary generate, trips GET/DELETE, transport search flight/train, bookings POST/GET, festivals). Frontend: home hero, plan page, map with Leaflet + satellite toggle, AI concierge chat (send + AI reply visible), bookings flow (search + book + PNR in Your Bookings) all work.
passed: GET /api/destinations returns 6 destinations (kerala, goa, rajasthan, himachal, tamilnadu, karnataka)
POST /api/chat returns AI reply from Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b (reply: 'Namaste')
GET /api/chat/{session_id} returns saved messages, DELETE clears them (ok:true)
POST /api/itinerary/generate returns Trip with itinerary[0].days and itinerary[0].budget_breakdown
GET /api/transport/search for flight & train returns options array (uses origin/destination params)
POST /api/bookings creates booking with PNR and status=CONFIRMED; GET /api/bookings lists them
Frontend home page loads with hero-cta-plan and Plan My Trip CTA
Frontend /plan page has plan-dest-kerala and plan-submit testids
Frontend /map renders Leaflet container and map-layer-toggle click works
Frontend AI Concierge FAB opens chat, message sent, AI reply 'Namaste' shown in chat-msg elements
Frontend /bookings: flight type + search shows 5 book options; booking with passenger name creates CONFIRMED booking with PNR (e.g., TMAC38C8) displayed in Your Bookings

failed.issue: For a 4-day trip (2025-12-20 to 2025-12-23) the AI returned only itinerary[0].days length = 1. Structure is correct (title, summary, budget_breakdown, festivals, days) but day count does not match trip duration.
failed.evidence: POST /api/itinerary/generate response: itinerary[0].days has 1 entry for 4-day trip

failed.issue: Clicking Book without entering passenger name silently fails (no visible error). Once passenger name is filled, booking works end-to-end. Consider validating and surfacing an error.
failed.evidence: First booking click without pax name -> Your Bookings still shows 'No bookings yet.'; with pax name -> booking appears with PNR

failed.issue: No elements matched [data-testid^='destination-card-'] on home page (destination cards likely only on Explore page). Not a blocker.

action_items: Investigate why Groq itinerary generation returns fewer days than trip duration (prompt/parsing) — may need to enforce day count in prompt or post-process to pad missing days.
Add client-side validation error on Bookings page when passenger name is empty before allowing Book click.

notes.mocked: Transport search and bookings are MOCKED (random PNR, static option data) as declared in review request.
notes.test_credentials: No auth in app; no credentials needed.
